mapper.sql: allowed.id, allowed.email, allowed.email_normalized, allowed.created_by, COALESCE(creator.display_name, creator.email) AS created_by_display_name, allowed.created_at, registered.id AS registered_user_id, registered.status AS registered_user_status
mapper.select: SELECT settings.id, settings.email_allowlist_enabled, settings.updated_by, COALESCE(updater.display_name, updater.email) AS updated_by_display_name, settings.updated_at FROM auth_beta_access_settings settings LEFT JOIN auth_users updater ON updater.id = settings.updated_by WHERE settings.id = 1
mapper.update: UPDATE auth_beta_access_settings SET email_allowlist_enabled = #{emailAllowlistEnabled}, updated_by = #{updatedBy}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE id = 1
mapper.select: SELECT FROM auth_beta_allowed_email allowed INNER JOIN auth_users creator ON creator.id = allowed.created_by LEFT JOIN auth_users registered ON registered.email_normalized = allowed.email_normalized WHERE allowed.id = #{allowedEmailId}

SELECT FROM auth_beta_allowed_email allowed INNER JOIN auth_users creator ON creator.id = allowed.created_by LEFT JOIN auth_users registered ON registered.email_normalized = allowed.email_normalized WHERE allowed.email_normalized = #{emailNormalized}

INSERT INTO auth_beta_allowed_email (email, email_normalized, created_by, created_at) VALUES (#{email}, #{emailNormalized}, #{createdBy}, #{createdAt}) ON CONFLICT (email_normalized) DO NOTHING RETURNING id

SELECT count(*) FROM auth_beta_allowed_email allowed
WHERE lower(allowed.email) LIKE concat('%', lower(#{keyword}), '%')

SELECT settings.email_allowlist_enabled, (SELECT count(*) FROM auth_beta_allowed_email) AS allowed_email_count, (SELECT count(*) FROM auth_beta_allowed_email allowed INNER JOIN auth_users users ON users.email_normalized = allowed.email_normalized) AS registered_allowed_email_count FROM auth_beta_access_settings settings WHERE settings.id = 1

SELECT users.id AS user_id, allowed.id AS allowed_email_id FROM auth_users users LEFT JOIN auth_beta_allowed_email allowed ON allowed.email_normalized = users.email_normalized WHERE users.id = #{userId}
